oneLine: Jio Platforms prepares a massive issue expected to bring multi-billion gains for early investors and promoters.

sources.title: Reliance-backed Jio Platforms IPO: ₹1 lakh crore gains for Meta, Google in ₹30,213 cr issue by Mukesh Ambani firm?

synopsis: Jio Platforms, a Reliance Industries-backed digital services company, is preparing to launch a fresh issue initial public offering to raise approximately ₹30,213 crore at an upper price band of ₹1,119 per equity share. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares with no offer-for-sale component. Existing shareholders including Meta Platforms (holding a 10% stake through Jaadhu Holdings LLC) and Google International LLC (holding a 7.73% stake) are not selling shares through the IPO. The proceeds are earmarked for the repayment or prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings of material subsidiary Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd and for general corporate purposes. The subscription dates are scheduled from Wednesday, October 21, to Friday, October 23, 2026, with anchor bidding on Monday, October 19, 2026. The price band is fixed at ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 per equity share.
